# Overlay and Edge Notes

> Field notes by Eugene Armstead (https://www.armsteadent.com/). Living specs with stable IDs. CC-BY-4.0. Placeholders only: <cloud-vps>, <lan-pi>, <overlay-peer>, <exit-node>, <wg-iface>, <gcp-nic>. Search the failure string: curl 200 chrome ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED; cscli capi 403; ts-forward TCPMSS 0 packets.

## How to find a spec

- Search the error you hit, not a private lab name.
- Notes live at [https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/).
- Agents start at this file and optionally [https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/llms-full.txt](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/llms-full.txt).
- Example searches: curl 200 chrome ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED; cscli capi 403; overlay SSH hang / ts-forward TCPMSS 0 packets.

## Original specs (built)

- [OEN-01 Overlay SSH stalls at a byte cliff](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/01-overlay-ssh-byte-cliff.html): Overlay SSH accepts login then hangs above about 1 KB when mesh underlay double-encapsulates through commercial WireGuard or when MSS is clamped on the wrong path.
- [OEN-02 Chromium TLS fails while curl returns 200](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/02-chromium-tls-pmtu.html): Chromium HTTPS can close during handshake while curl still returns 200 because the browser ClientHello is larger than curl and path MTU discovery is blackholed.
- [OEN-03 Router VPN DNS hijack looks like a path-MTU problem](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/03-router-vpn-dns-hijack.html): Consumer-router VPN DNS Server fields can destination-NAT LAN port 53 into the tunnel, producing hung DNS and browser timeouts that look like a path-MTU failure.
- [OEN-04 Exit-node TCP maximum-segment-size clamp after ts-forward never runs](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/04-exit-tcpmss-after-ts-forward.html): TCPMSS rules in FORWARD after jump ts-forward never see exit SYNs; insert the clamp at the top of ts-forward and re-apply after the overlay daemon rewrites chains.
- [OEN-05 Exit-node overlay peer-API DNS stub (loopback only)](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/05-exit-peerapi-dns-stub.html): Android exit DNS is overlay peer-API DNS over HTTPS on a dynamic port. A loopback stub that forces Recursion Desired works; binding the stub on the overlay address:53 breaks all exit.
- [OEN-06 Netfilter-off IPv6 return-path blackhole](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/06-netfilter-off-v6-return.html): With overlay netfilter off, an nft prerouting mark does not win the first IPv6 route lookup. Use one ip6tables path and install the overlay unique-local /48 on table 52 and main.
- [OEN-07 CrowdSec Central API HTTP 403 from native health probes](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/07-crowdsec-capi-403.html): Native systemd health and fleet collectors that loop cscli capi status can 403 a Virtual Private Server IPv4 the same way Docker healthchecks do. Dummy enroll POST distinguishes banned IPv4 from a dead install.
- [OEN-12 Consumer-router WireGuard FORWARD only on a phantom bridge](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/12-consumer-wg-phantom-bridge.html): Merlin-class firmware may allow FORWARD only for a guest bridge that does not exist, so the router can curl through WireGuard while LAN clients have no internet.
- [OEN-13 Overlay ≠ underlay ≠ tunnel unique-local ≠ LAN unique-local](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/13-overlay-underlay-ula-layers.html): Four address layers get conflated: WAN global, overlay unique-local, commercial-tunnel addresses, and LAN unique-local. Bind overlay services to specific overlay v4 and node unique-local, not WAN ::.
- [OEN-14 Exit app DNS is overlay peer-API, not coordinator Unbound](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/14-exit-dns-is-peerapi.html): dig against the coordinator nameserver can succeed while apps are DNS-dead. Exit-client DNS is HTTPS to the exit’s peer-API dns-query endpoint.
- [OEN-15 Split host vs overlay resolver views on the coordinator VPS](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/15-split-host-vs-overlay-resolver.html): The coordinator host resolver on loopback MUST keep working when the commercial tunnel is down. The overlay nameserver view MAY fail in that state if it forwards through the tunnel.
- [OEN-16 Commercial WireGuard endpoint rotation (IPv6, shuffle bag, hub watch)](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/16-commercial-wg-endpoint-rotation.html): IPv6-only WireGuard rotation fails when health checks ride the tunnel: use WAN curl -6, ULA egress verify, a shuffle bag, and a hub watch.
- [OEN-17 Google Cloud overlay exit (IP forwarding, listen port, Identity-Aware Proxy)](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/17-gcp-overlay-exit.html): A Google Cloud virtual machine can advertise an overlay exit only with IP forwarding, both default routes, a fixed overlay UDP listen port, scoped network address translation, and Identity-Aware Proxy as break-glass — not as the daily door.
- [OEN-18 Per-node changelog contract (repo + hashed on-device copy)](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/18-per-node-changelog-contract.html): Per-node changelog hash mismatch: the ops-repo file is canonical; sync a hashed on-device copy the same session, with path class by node type.
- [OEN-19 Local Unbound REFUSES overlay peer-API queries with Recursion Desired off](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/19-unbound-refuses-rd0.html): Exit peer-API DNS over HTTPS sends Recursion Desired off. dnsmasq pointed at loopback Unbound returns REFUSED, which looks like Unbound is down.
- [OEN-20 LAN unique-local + remote exit: IPv4 takes the exit, IPv6 leaks](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/20-lan-ula-happy-eyeballs-leak.html): On home Wi-Fi a remote exit can carry IPv4 while browsers prefer IPv6 via the LAN unique-local default into the commercial VPN. Cellular without that unique-local looks fully on the exit.
- [OEN-21 Shared commercial-VPN network address translation: CrowdSec bans the whole house](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/21-shared-vpn-nat-crowdsec-ban.html): Many LAN and overlay clients share one commercial VPN egress IP. CrowdSec banning that address takes down coordination and SSH for everyone while overlay direct UDP often still works.
- [OEN-22 Delayed WireGuard start wipes FORWARD with no restart event](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/22-delayed-wg-forward-wipe.html): Boot applies LAN-to-WireGuard FORWARD early; firmware starts the client minutes later and rewrites FORWARD without a restart event. Tunnel is up, LAN is dead, counters stay 0.
- [OEN-23 Cloud-exit accept-dns=true pretty-prints, breaks overlay peer-API DNS](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/23-cloud-exit-accept-dns.html): On Google Compute Engine-like hosts, accept-dns=true makes tailscale dns query look pretty and breaks the Recursion Desired-off exit DNS path.
- [OEN-08 Do not ship localhost debug beacons in Worker HTML](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/web/08-worker-html-localhost-debug.html): Agent debug templates that fetch 127.0.0.1 ingest URLs must never ship in Cloudflare Worker HTML; browsers prompt for local-network access on public HTTPS pages.
- [OEN-09 Git merge is not a live Worker (timed Wrangler fallback)](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/web/09-git-merge-is-not-a-live-worker.html): A merged git source of truth is not a live Cloudflare Worker. Wait about ten minutes, then Wrangler without asking. Workers-edit tokens often lack Cache Purge.
- [OEN-10 One generated blocking stylesheet and variable fonts](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/web/10-one-blocking-stylesheet-variable-fonts.html): A new render-blocking stylesheet dropped mobile PageSpeed. Per-weight variable font filenames made Chrome re-download the same woff2. Generate one chrome.css; preload at most two matching variable files.
- [OEN-11 Worker chat wrapper, Turnstile, sanitize large-language-model drift](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/web/11-worker-chat-wrapper-turnstile.html): Iframe a Worker chat only when copy is stable. Otherwise use a same-origin wrapper, optional reverse-proxy API, send official FAQ every request, strip forbidden phrases client-side, gate with Turnstile.

## Supporting specs (built)

- [OEN-S01 Don't-fragment ping size ladder (path MTU discovery)](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s01-pmtud-size-ladder.html): Measure path MTU with don't-fragment ping size ladders on IPv4 and IPv6. Small ICMP can succeed while large TCP still dies.
- [OEN-S02 clamp-mss-to-pmtu is a no-op when ICMP is dropped](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s02-clamp-mss-to-pmtu-noop.html): iptables --clamp-mss-to-pmtu uses learned path MTU. When ICMP fragmentation-needed is blackholed, the clamp does nothing; use explicit --set-mss.
- [OEN-S03 1 KB vs 1 MB transfer matrix + ControlPath=none](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s03-transfer-matrix-controlpath.html): Prove overlay SSH size: 1 KB vs about 1 MB with ControlPath=none. Mux death is a symptom. Userspace overlay SSH is less forgiving than kernel SSH on the same host.
- [OEN-S04 Purge the content delivery network after deploy](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s04-purge-cdn-after-deploy.html): After a successful deploy, purge HTML. Workers-edit tokens often lack Cache Purge. Query-string cache busts do not replace a zone purge for HTML.
- [OEN-S05 Tunnel preview HIT with a stale body](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s05-tunnel-preview-stale-hit.html): Origin can already be new while a Cloudflare Tunnel preview still serves HIT with a stale body until the preview URL is purged.
- [OEN-S06 Do not ship HTML-only](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s06-do-not-ship-html-only.html): CSS, JavaScript, and images must return 200. A layout-destroying miss looks like a CSS bug.
- [OEN-S07 Git merge 405 while mergeability is pending](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s07-git-merge-405-pending.html): HTTP 405 on merge right after opening a merge request is usually mergeability still pending, not a dead token. Contrast with real 401.
- [OEN-S08 Canonical disk + tmpfs RAM origin on a Pi](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s08-canonical-disk-tmpfs-origin.html): Deploy to the persistent disk tree, then sync to a tmpfs RAM origin so the content delivery network hits RAM, not the SD card.
- [OEN-S09 Playwright Desktop + iPhone + Pixel](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s09-playwright-desktop-iphone-pixel.html): Layout, nav, and hero changes need Desktop Chrome, iPhone, and Pixel device projects. WebKit binaries are not required for this gate.
- [OEN-S10 file(1) before image deploy](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s10-file-before-image-deploy.html): Extension is not format. Map source to destination by actual type from file(1). Do not swap look-alike attachments.
- [OEN-S11 Overlay session-mirror remote desktop and access-control list without deny](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s11-overlay-rdp-acl.html): The overlay is an access plane, not only SSH. Session-mirror remote desktop plus a locked-screen extension. Coordination ACLs with no deny action need port-range allow holes. Generic peers only.
- [OEN-S12 Rocket Loader Off](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s12-rocket-loader-off.html): Cloudflare Rocket Loader rewrites inline scripts and breaks analytics and Playwright smoke. Turn it Off on marketing and app routes.
- [OEN-S13 Restart=always on a missing unit hung the workstation](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s13-restart-always-missing-unit.html): Restart=always on a missing ExecStart produced 150k+ failed restarts plus leftover units binding another host’s addresses on a 2-core box.
- [OEN-S14 Broadcom in-kernel WireGuard SUnreclaim (flow-cache/runner A/B fail)](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s14-broadcom-wg-sunreclaim.html): In-kernel WireGuard on a Broadcom consumer router leaked about 6–8 MB/h of SUnreclaim. drop_caches did not free it. Flow-cache off and runner off A/Bs were negative.
- [OEN-S15 Router squashfs is always 100%; Save settings misses persistent overlay](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s15-router-squashfs-jffs.html): Router root squashfs reports 100% full; that is normal. Save settings .cfg does not include the persistent overlay scripts. Save JFFS separately. logread is OpenWrt — this firmware uses syslog files.
- [OEN-S16 Never nft flush / never start stock nftables.service](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s16-never-nft-flush.html): Never nft flush ruleset and never start stock nftables.service on a host that also runs UFW, CrowdSec, and custom exit tables. Tunnel predown MUST delete only named custom tables.
- [OEN-S17 Coordination CLI blocks on SQLite write-ahead log while serve is up](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s17-coordination-cli-sqlite-wal.html): Coordination nodes-list CLI can block minutes on SQLite WAL while serve is up. Health checks MUST use HTTP /health or a readonly sqlite query, not the admin CLI.
- [OEN-S18 Do not set exit-node on the agent workstation](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s18-do-not-set-exit-on-agent-workstation.html): Do not tailscale set --exit-node on the agent workstation unless the operator asks. Overlay SSH first. nmap only after a failed connect.
- [OEN-S19 Push small overlay snapshots; do not copy-pull large JSON](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s19-push-small-overlay-snapshots.html): Fleet snapshots: push small chunks to the hub. Do not SCP-pull large JSON over overlay SSH or you hit the byte cliff.
- [OEN-S20 SSH TCP-open with no banner is userspace-sick](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s20-ssh-open-no-banner.html): Overlay SSH TCP-open with no banner means userspace on the router is sick. nmap open is not enough. Reboot restores banner and PeerAPI together.
- [OEN-S21 Cloud exit hairpins home LAN HTTP while overlay SSH still works](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s21-cloud-exit-hairpin-lan.html): With a cloud exit selected, overlay SSH to the router still works while HTTP to LAN DNS/GUI dies. Not a broken router. Clear the exit on the workstation.
- [OEN-S22 Identity-Aware Proxy is break-glass; overlay SSH key-exchange can fail on some cloud VMs](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s22-iap-break-glass-kex.html): Identity-Aware Proxy is recovery. Overlay product ssh CLI may fail key exchange on some Google Compute Engine images — use plain OpenSSH. Never reset the instance as a debug step.
- [OEN-S23 Cloud firewall UDP 41641 is useless while overlay PORT=0](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s23-vpc-41641-useless-while-port-0.html): A VPC allow for UDP 41641 does nothing while the overlay daemon has PORT=0 (ephemeral). Ship PORT, daemon restart, guest firewall, and VPC together. Never leave PORT empty.
- [OEN-S24 LAN DNS returning 0.0.0.0 is a sinkhole, not a site bug](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s24-lan-dns-sinkhole-0-0-0-0.html): LAN dig returning 0.0.0.0 is a DNS sinkhole. Compare LAN dig vs DNS-over-HTTPS. Temporary /etc/hosts on the workstation only, operator-approved. Not a website bug.
- [OEN-S25 Network Time Security chrony address-family flags need a newer chrony than the distro](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s25-chrony-nts-address-family.html): Distro chrony may not parse NTS ipv6/ipv4 server flags. Use a newer chrony plus Cloudflare NTS; try v6 then v4.
- [OEN-S26 Wi-Fi underlay vs cellular underlay to the same cloud exit](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s26-wifi-vs-cellular-underlay.html): Home Wi-Fi may encapsulate overlay inside commercial WireGuard; cellular may go direct. IPv4 can show the cloud while IPv6 leaks the home tunnel. Not “the GCP exit is broken.”
- [OEN-S27 iptables-nft PREROUTING MARK does not win before the forwarding information base](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s27-iptables-nft-mark-before-fib.html): Counters look marked; ip -6 route get overlay-ula iif tunnel still shows the WAN NIC. Need mark and overlay ULA /48 on table 52 and main. Split nft plus ip6tables MASQUERADE breaks conntrack.
- [OEN-S28 Reconnect during overlay peer-API outage sticks after heal](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s28-sticky-reconnect-during-peerapi-outage.html): Phones that rejoin while DoH is dead stay stuck after PeerAPI recovers until that client toggles. Heal the exit stub, not coordinator DNS yaml. Empty use_with_exit_node does not open PeerAPI.
- [OEN-S29 Overlay peer-API stub event-loop blocks; UDP receive queue grows](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s29-peerapi-stub-event-loop.html): Synchronous upstream inside select() fills UDP recv-Q; cellular DNS dies. Thread pool plus timeouts.
- [OEN-S30 TS_DEBUG_MTU below 1280 disables overlay IPv6](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s30-ts-debug-mtu-below-1280.html): TS_DEBUG_MTU below 1280 makes the kernel drop IPv6 on the overlay tun. Do not use it as a production clamp.
- [OEN-S31 prefixes.v6 needs nodes backfillips, not restart alone](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s31-prefixes-v6-needs-backfillips.html): Enabling prefixes.v6 on existing nodes needs nodes backfillips --force then restart. Restart alone leaves tailscale ip -6 empty.
- [OEN-S32 DNS leak-test green is not IPv6 data-plane green](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s32-dns-leak-test-not-v6-dataplane.html): A leak-test resolver name can look OK while ::/0 TCP times out. DNS and IPv6 data are different paths.
- [OEN-S33 Consumer-router cron PATH omits curl; watchdog log() + set -e exits](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s33-router-cron-path-set-e.html): Consumer-router cron PATH may omit /usr/sbin and curl. A log() that returns 1 with set -e exits the watchdog every tick — silent skip, stale status.
- [OEN-S34 CrowdSec free-tier Central API login budget](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/supporting/s34-crowdsec-capi-login-budget.html): CrowdSec free-tier about 20 CAPI logins per 50 minutes per source IP yields HTTP 403 for about an hour. Cache cscli capi status; do not loop it.
